Bowl outer diameter is about 255 px, which at roughly 15 cm for a cereal bowl gives about 0.059 cm per px. The food surface is about 200 px wide, so roughly 12 cm across.

Assuming the porridge fills a bowl of about 12 cm diameter and 4 cm depth, its volume is roughly a spherical cap. With radius 6 cm and height 4 cm, V = πh(3r² + h²)/6 = π × 4 × (108 + 16)/6 ≈ 260 ml. The porridge is dense, so that is about 260 g. The bowl looks fairly full, so I'll estimate about 270 g.

The porridge looks like oatmeal or rice porridge with some orange bits, possibly carrot or sweet potato.
